turns.text: I ordered a custom print of the house where I grew up. It arrived Monday and I'd like to return it.
I'm sorry your print didn't arrive as you hoped. To look into a return, I need your order number (it looks like SC- followed by four digits) and the email address you used when you placed the order.
That's SC-2214. The checkout email was rowan.bellwick@example.com.

Thank you, Rowan. I've found order SC-2214, the custom print of The House Behind the Mulberry Gate. Our return policy covers catalogue prints only, which can be returned within 14 days of delivery, with the customer paying return postage and staff approving any refund. Custom commissioned work like this one is not eligible for return, so I can't file a return for this order. If the print arrived damaged or not as described, please tell me what is wrong and I can file a damage claim for staff to review.

items.title: The House Behind the Mulberry Gate

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.
